output.level_0: Alerts fire randomly during the morning window, causing unnecessary panic and ignored warnings.
output.level_1: No alerts exist, so forecast failures are only discovered when shelves are empty.
output.level_2: A human checks the dashboard every morning and calls the team if something looks wrong.
output.level_3: The system sends automated alerts to the on call engineer when forecast latency spikes.
output.level_4: Alerts are governed by severity rules, with audit logs and automatic escalation to leadership.
